column1: # Bench panel: Rebelo et al. 2011 (doi:10.1177/1040638711416846), pan-Mycoplasma
# 16S-23S intergenic spacer PCR with HRM.
# The paper's inclusivity claim, read 2026-10-20 from papers/: "All 10 Mycoplasma
# reference strains tested generated HRM profiles with 2 melting peaks", i.e. every
# species in its panel amplified. So every row here is `band`, and the panel measures
# false fails, as the Forslund FAP panel does.
# The 10 species are M. bovis, arginini, bovirhinis, spumans, iowae, bovigenitalium,
# meleagridis, canadense, agalactiae, cynos. Two are missing below: M. spumans and
# M. canadense have no GenBank record spanning the 16S-23S spacer at all (checked
# 2026-10-20), so this assay cannot be assessed against them in silico at any
# threshold. That is a gap in the archive, not a property of the assay.
# One record per species: the RefSeq complete genome where one exists, else a record
# covering the 16S-23S region. Most of these species now sit in Mycoplasmopsis;
# the labels keep the paper's names. Rebelo used its own reference strains, so a
# record here can differ from the strain that was on the bench.
